name: DailyTrade
summary: 100% Free Paper Trading Simulator with Real Live Market Prices
description:
DailyTrade is a minimalist, open-source paper trading app inspired by TradingView. Practice trading stocks, crypto, crude oil, forex, index mutual funds, and fixed deposits with zero money and zero risk.

Key Highlights:
- Real-time sub-second Binance WebSocket crypto streaming
- Live Yahoo Finance feeds for 120+ global assets
- Pure black OLED minimalist TradingView aesthetic
- Market orders, limit orders, Stop Loss & Take Profit (OCO)
- 100% offline-first local storage, zero telemetry, zero account required

Developer: Luxie47 (luxie47@gmail.com | Discord: Luxie47)
Main Project: DailyFlow (https://dailyflow-luxie.vercel.app)
